payload.title: We're changing auto mode to no longer charge for classifier requests in Claude Code.
paragraphs: However, this session isn't eligible because your requests go through 127.0.0.1:8641, which isn't compatible with this update.
Nothing breaks: auto mode keeps working, and its classifier requests are billed as before.
To fix it and access the new version of auto mode, ask your gateway to implement: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
